title: QA agents configuration
description: Per-team settings for the test case drafting and QMetry push workflow. Secrets never go here; they belong in .env.

documentRole.description: What generated documents call the engineering role.

site.description: Atlassian site host, e.g. your-site.atlassian.net. Used through the Atlassian MCP, never called directly.

projectKey.description: Default Jira project key, e.g. PROJ.

baseUrl.description: QMetry Open API base URL. Change it for a non-global region, e.g. https://syd-qtmcloud.qmetry.com/rest/api/latest.

projectKey.description: QMetry project key. Usually the same as the Jira project key.

priorityMap.description: CSV priority name to QMetry priority name. The CSV uses High, Normal and Low; map each to a priority your project defines.

caseStatus.description: Test case status to set on push, e.g. Done. null leaves the project default.

labels.description: Whether a push creates and applies labels (ticket key, category, technique, level).

mainFolder.description: Default main test case folder path, e.g. Sprint_26. null means the push asks every time.

markAiGenerated.description: Sets QMetry's aiGenerated flag on every pushed test case, so cases drafted by the test-craft agent can be filtered and reported on in QMetry. Turn off only if your governance policy says otherwise.

defaultTier.description: Coverage tier used when /test-craft is run without one.
